parts.t: Welcome to this exceptional 1 Bedroom + 1 Den condo in Clayton/Cloverdale. Discover executive-style living at its finest, ideally situated near Willowbrook Mall and convenient bus transit. This home features a spacious den, perfect for a home office or private dining area. Embrace the inviting ambiance of the open floor plan complemented by a cozy fireplace in the living room. The master bedroom offers a walk-in closet for ample storage. Noteworthy, we include 2 designated parking spaces for your ease. With a beautiful park just steps away, seize the opportunity to make this outstanding residence yours – act fast, it won't be available for long.
